---
name: Observed user-test bug
about: Report a defect actually observed while testing
labels: user-test-bug
---

## Observed defect

Date, revision, browser/device/environment, impact, and sanitized evidence:

## Reproduction steps

1. State prerequisites and actions.

## Expected behavior

Link the requirement or accepted criterion.

## Actual behavior

Describe what actually happened; include frequency and errors without secrets.

## Goal

Describe the corrected user outcome.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The reproduction now matches the expected behavior.
- [ ] Relevant regression checks and independent QA evidence are recorded.

## Out of scope

List unrelated work and link follow-ups.

## Constraints

- Check duplicates before submitting; use only for an observed defect.
- Dependencies / affected stage:
- PM refines; engineer fixes; independent QA records each criterion.
- Only QA closes after PASS.
